verdict.rationale: Otter's docs support cross-platform capture (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet) via scheduled bot-join or bot-free desktop/browser recording, giving PMs nominal control over where recording happens (otter-docs-17, otter-docs-2, otter-docs-38, otter-docs-15). However, independent hands-on reports directly contradict reliable placement control: an unexplained Otter bot repeatedly rejoined a call despite the user trying to remove it, bots joined confidential meetings unbidden, and recordings/summaries were shared without consent, undermining the 'recording where I want it' promise (otter-comm-8, otter-comm-1, otter-comm-6, otter-comm-7). Missing for 10: no independent verification of consistent scheduling accuracy across all three platforms, no resolution/fix documentation for the uncontrolled bot-join complaints, and no data on transcription reliability across accents beyond one mixed anecdote.
